Changed owner() to return _msgSender() instead of state variable _owner.
Replace the require statement with an empty statement, allowing transfer of ownership to the zero address.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(_msgSender()), causing ownership to remain with the caller instead of transferring to newOwner.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with no-op, leaving ownership unchanged despite a successful call.
Delete the require statement, allowing transfer of ownership to the zero address.
Delete the _transferOwnership(newOwner) call, so ownership never changes but the call succeeds.
Replace require(owner() == _msgSender()) with require(true), removing the only-owner restriction entirely.
Delete the require statement body, removing the only-owner restriction so anyone can call transferOwnership.
